prompt:
Do exactly these steps, one tool call each, in order, no explanations:
1) Use the Write tool to create hello.txt containing 'hello world'.
2) Use the Edit tool to change 'world' to 'there' in hello.txt.
3) Use the MultiEdit tool (if it is unavailable, use Edit) to make two changes at once in hello.txt: 'hello' -> 'hi' and 'there' -> 'friend'.
4) Use the Write tool to overwrite hello.txt with 'overwritten'.
5) Run the Bash command: ls -la
6) Run this Bash command using a heredoc:
cat <<'EOF' > notes.txt
line one
line two
EOF
7) Run this multi-line Bash chain:
git status && \
  git add -A && \
  git commit -qm 'scratch: add files' && git log --oneline
Then say DONE.
